## Appearance

Diana is described as a very pretty girl with black eyes, crimson or rosy cheeks, and dimples. She has glossy, jet-black hair and curls, as well as a merry facial expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Personality

A ladylike girl with a merry expression, Diana is known for her practical nature as well as her notable taste in dressing. She displays an unselfish admiration for the gifts and graces of her friends and possesses the ability to make a splendid lettuce salad. Her heart is set on taking music lessons.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XIX. ## History

When Diana Barry was born, she was named by a boarding schoolmaster, and as a young girl, she belonged to a childhood [Story Club](../codex/factions.md#story-club). She formed an instant bond with [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her garden, pledging to be her lifelong bosom friend. Soon after, their friendship faced a crisis when Diana's mother temporarily forbade them from playing together after a misunderstanding, leading to a tearful farewell; however, the relationship was restored when Diana sought Anne's help to nurse her sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) through severe croup. Diana later participated in a successful [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) concert with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and subsequently rushed to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to deliver the news that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) had tied for first place on the entrance exam. As they grew older, Diana canvassed for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), went on picnics where she shared local history, and accompanied [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) on misadventures that included getting stuck in a duck house roof and discovering [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Despite fearing she would be left behind when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) pursued higher education, Diana became engaged to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) and later married him at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Following her marriage, Diana gave birth to a son, little [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), welcoming [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to her home to visit her new baby.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> “Yes,” said Diana, tossing her head, “but I’m sure he doesn’t like Julia Bell so very much. I’ve heard him say he studied the multiplication table by her freckles.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P19](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0019)

> “Those Pye girls are cheats all round,” said Diana indignantly, as they climbed the fence of the main road. “Gertie Pye actually went and put her milk bottle in my place in the brook yesterday. Did you ever? I don’t speak to her now.”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P26](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0026)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)
